angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 281,063 km at 37.28 pc = 0.1 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 26.8266 +/- 0.0181 mas (same row, RUWE 1.48): 37.28 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.404 +/- 0.012 solar radii from Thao et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1224 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract): 281,063 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.4 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Thao et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1224 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3326 +/- 66 K from Thao et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1224 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Thao et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1224 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1224.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.827, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-1224: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1224 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.6968, from Thao et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1224 (pscomppars): age 0.21 Gyr, from Thao et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1224 (pscomppars): rotation period 1.23 d, from Thao et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...41T/abstract)
